name: TOR
architecture: multi-hop relay routing with layered encryption
privacy_properties: traffic passes through multiple intermediary relays
service observations may not expose the originating network path
investigation_constraints: a service-level address is not automatically the user's address
origin attribution requires corroboration beyond the observed relay endpoint
legitimate_uses: privacy protection for journalists, activists, and other lawful users
scope_boundary: TOR context does not establish criminal intent or identify a user

name: I2P
architecture: decentralized anonymous network using garlic routing
privacy_properties: multiple messages may be combined in layered encryption
the design does not rely on a centralized database of server nodes
investigation_constraints: a single central node view should not be treated as the complete communication path
interpretation depends on the activity type and the network context
legitimate_uses: private communication and access to online material
scope_boundary: I2P context does not establish criminal intent or guarantee complete anonymity

name: Freenet
architecture: decentralized peer-to-peer content distribution through intermediary nodes
privacy_properties: encrypted content chunks may be distributed across users' computers
users may not know which files their nodes store or which node supplied a file
investigation_constraints: storage or forwarding does not establish authorship or intent
a requested content identifier does not by itself identify the requester or publisher
legitimate_uses: content distribution, publishing, communication, and access to information
scope_boundary: Freenet participation does not establish possession, authorship, or criminal intent
